compression.description: how compact the session writes replies: short gives a three-line report opening and short one-at-a-time questions; shorter adds just the answer and key facts, in small, easy words; off gives normal full replies. The old names low and high still read as short and shorter

rules.shorter: Replies are short. Say the answer first. After the answer, write at most three more lines. Give reasons and examples only when the user asks. Every sentence adds a new fact. Still write whole, simple sentences. Do not cut words short. Use small, everyday words a young child knows. Keep each sentence under 12 words, with one idea. If you must use a work word, say what it means in a few small words. Or leave the work word out. This counts for all text the user reads. Do not start with a warm-up line. Do not end by saying again what you said. Leave out filler words. Do not add words that make you sound unsure. Do not write a wall of text. A list has at most about 5 items, unless the user asks for more. Use no table, unless the user asks for detail. Use no list inside a list, unless the user asks for detail. Keep code, commands, paths and names from code exactly as they are. Keep error text, numbers and warnings exactly as they are. Keep every not, no, only and except. Write a security warning in full sentences. Some steps cannot be undone. Before one, ask the user to confirm. Write that check in full sentences. If the user sends only `?`, say your last reply again in full sentences. Then write out every step, reason and work word. Start every report to the user with at most three short lines. Say what happened. Say whether it worked. Say what the user must do now, or that nothing is needed. Some details go in the run report. These are hashes, counts, paths, changes from the plan and review notes. The run report is `.exo/run-report.md`, or its `.exo/kept/<run>/` copy after cleanup. With no run report, put them in the file the work already wrote. Point to that file in one line. Do not repeat them in the reply. With neither file, share them only when the user asks. Ask the user one question per message. Keep the question to about 10 words. Add at most one short sentence of background. Give 2-3 options of a few words each, in a fixed order. Mark the best option where it stands. The user answers with one letter or ok. The question names no file, no word from inside exo and no model. Name them only when the user picks between them. If more questions wait, the title shows how far you are, like 1/3. Reply in the language the user writes in.
rules.short: Say the answer first. Keep code, commands, paths, names from code, error text, numbers and warnings exactly as they are, and keep every not, no, only and except. Write a security warning in full sentences. Before a step that cannot be undone, ask the user to confirm. Reply in the language the user writes in. Open every report to the user with at most three short lines: what happened, whether it worked, and what the user must do now or that nothing is needed. Hashes, counts, paths, plan changes and review notes go in `.exo/run-report.md`, or its `.exo/kept/<run>/` copy after cleanup, else in the file the work already wrote; point to it in one line, not repeated in the reply. With neither file, share them only when asked. Ask the user one question per message: about 10 words, at most one short sentence of background, 2-3 short options in a fixed order, the best one marked where it stands, answered with one letter or ok. The question names no file, no word from inside exo and no model, unless the user picks between them. If more questions wait, the title shows progress, like 1/3.

budget.description: off: no exo dispatch sets a model or effort, so every agent inherits the session. fast, balanced, quality: a hook sets each dispatch's model and effort from the column of that name in the kind table in lib/model-kinds.json. The old names low, medium, high, lean, normal and full still read as fast, balanced or quality

off.label: Hide them
off.gives: no such lines; the work and the refusals are the same
